scripts.build:extension: python -c "import os, zipfile; zipf = zipfile.ZipFile('paisawise-extension.zip', 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED); [zipf.write(os.path.join(r, f), os.path.relpath(os.path.join(r, f), 'extension')) for r, d, files in os.walk('extension') for f in files if not f.endswith('.zip')]; print('Built paisawise-extension.zip')"
